name: Told a fact, Boop keeps a note; praise it doesn't
why: HARNESS.md §5 and steering.md (Remembering, Writing): a fact the person tells Boop becomes today's note, in a few plain words; praise and greetings never do

input.words: remember the demo is on Thursday

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, voice: mumble, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*demo*Thursday*", where: today)
you said → react(feeling: proud|happy|excited, voice: mumble, word: thanks|love|yay|good|hooray|nice|none)
